Guided step-by-step by a professional artist, this workshop is soothing, experimental, and perfect for beginners.

All materials are included, just come ready to play with colors, explore fluid techniques, and create your own beautifully blended compositions.

featured_reviews.name: Sakshi Deshpande
featured_reviews.review_text:
To Describe this place or the people here in just one word, i would say its ’Home’. ❤️
The place where you get all the comfort, you get to learn things more than you ever thought that existed, you get the support of the amazing and supremely talented people, an environment you crave to stay and never leave. Two years ago, when I walked into Asmita Applied Art Academy with a heart full of uncertainty, i knew for a fact, that i am at the RIGHT PLACE, and i wish i would have gotten here a little bit sooner. After every session and each day, you walk out not just with skills and knowledge, but with a lifetime of experience and a deep sense of gratitude. This place has truly been a journey. A place where creativity found direction, where raw talent was shaped with care and conviction. The atmosphere, the energy, and the sheer passion that echoes through its walls made every moment here unforgettable. In true sense a ‘LITERAL PLACE OF SUNSHINE’ ✨
A huge part of this magic comes from the unwavering guidance, and mentorship of Ashish Sir. His dedication, patience, and belief in every student is what makes Asmita so special. He means it truly when he says that “He doesn’t teach his children, He simply creates an environment to learn”. Ashish Sir has been the most amazing guide, mentor you could find, with the unmatched artistic vision, and many more. And special mention to Vaishali Mam, who is genuinely a sweetheart. The bold ness and creative brilliance she carries is truly inspiring. And when you have such amazing mentors, you are constantly reminded of pushing your boundaries and to think fearlessly. Because people like them don’t just teach art — they teach how to believe in ourselves. Beyond grateful to have such amazing people to shape your path of life.
Asmita will forever be etched in my heart. It’s more than just an academy; it’s a family you will always carry with.

PS: There’s a quote written on the wall stating, “What i have not seen is infinitely more than what i have seen”. But trust me, if you are in this place, you already have seen, and learn more than half of the infinites. 😌

featured_reviews.name: Nishant Choudhary
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’m currently in my second year of BFA at NIFA (National Institute of Fine Arts), and the growth I’ve experienced here has been truly meaningful. In just over a year, my confidence, observation skills, and technical ability have improved in a way that reflects directly in my artworks.

Now, whenever I look at any subject or object, I feel equipped to translate it onto paper or canvas — something I couldn’t imagine before joining. This transformation has been possible because of the solid foundation and consistent mentorship provided at NIFA.

The classrooms are filled with beautiful and inspiring artworks, which constantly motivate us to aim higher. Being in such a creative space naturally builds discipline, focus, and artistic energy.

I’ve trained in multiple mediums here, including fine pen, acrylic, oil paints, watercolor, charcoal, and pencil shading. The guidance from Madhu Sir and Mandar Sir has been the most valuable part of my journey. Their experience, personal attention, and honest feedback have helped me grow both technically and creatively.

Alongside regular classes, NIFA also organizes enriching workshops like the Caricature Art Workshop, which allow us to explore different art styles and techniques beyond the syllabus.

You can view my art journey and progress on Instagram: @nishantchoudhary.arts — a reflection of everything I’ve learned here.

Even as I move forward in my art career, I will always remain a student of NIFA, and of Madhu Sir and Mandar Sir. I’m thankful to be part of this institute and highly recommend it to anyone serious about building their future in fine arts.

featured_reviews.name: Vipul Mehra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited the legendary Sir J.J. School of Arts for a weekend sketch meet-up with Urban Sketchers Mumbai. The campus is dotted with sculptures and paintings created by students, quietly inhabiting every corner. Lush trees, the presence of many birds, and a heritage building—likely over a century old—give the place a timeless charm.
There is something about this institute that words struggle to capture. It seems to breathe artistic energy and passion. As I walked through the campus, I saw students deeply immersed in sculpting stone, shaping wood, and carving logs. Watching them so absorbed in their work felt like witnessing yogis in meditation—unaware of passersby, untouched by the world around them.
This heritage institute has nurtured some of the finest artists and architects in the country. Though I never had the fortune of studying here, I have learned immensely about art through colleagues and friends who are graduates of this institution.

featured_reviews.name: Big Jay from Nepal
featured_reviews.review_text: I would love to give a review of this revered institution as i have heard so many tales from my mother as its her alma mater and some of her contemporaries are now famous on their own rights.With Harshad Rajadhyaksha  a prominent creative leader in Indian advertising, currently serving as a Chief Creative Officer (CCO) at Ogilvy and many others who are a force to recon in this field. So back to Sir.J.J.School of Art,which stands unmoved in a world of its own.Steeped in heritage and covered in greens,the omnipresent aroma of talent and hope of the next great master of art,this 150 years old building has survived the boom years and stands stoically in the face of the changing times.With many illutrious teachers and Deans alike who came after lockwood Kipling,father of poet Rudyard Kipling,these faculty members have contributed in major ways in reiterating the European school of art with traditional Indian art and in the pricess have chosen to retain the western influences in art education.While you are there make sure to visit the library which is the oldest and most well equipped library in the art world.Also the studio facilities for both Fine and Applied arts are the best in the country.The school also houses some rare collection of art in the form of paintings,drawings,murals,sculptures, ceramic works and metal works.My mom adds that the canteen a hub of activity is the heart of the campus and holds many fond memories for her as well as ex students of this prestigious institution.

I have done clay workshop before but her way of teaching is much better than others as she really takes effort in her work. It was a fun day at her beautiful studio.

featured_reviews.name: Milind Save
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently attended Fedora's texture painting workshop and it was lit 🔥! The session was super enjoyable and totally worth my time. Fedora's guidance helped me explore a new dimension of painting - literally! 😄 Working with different textures added so much depth to my art, and I loved experimenting with the techniques she shared.

Fedora is an awesome instructor - patient, knowledgeable, and made sure everyone was comfortable trying out stuff. The workshop vibe was chill yet creative, perfect for picking up new skills or just having fun with art. If you're into exploring texture painting or want to add some pizzazz to your art, I'd say this workshop is worth checking out! 👍
-Milind

featured_reviews.name: mugdha sakpal
featured_reviews.review_text: Attended today's texture art workshop! Must say it was an amazing experience. Fedora is very professional and explains everything in great details. The workshop is very beneficial for anybody wanting to learn texture art.

featured_reviews.name: Sneha Abraham
featured_reviews.review_text: Fedora’s art workshop was a truly enriching and soul-nourishing experience. Thoughtfully planned and beautifully executed, the session perfectly encapsulated a mindfulness approach that left me feeling both grounded and creatively inspired. Every detail — from the materials provided to the gentle pace of instruction — encouraged presence, self-expression, and inner calm. It was more than just an art class; it was a therapeutic journey that invited us to slow down, connect with ourselves, and express freely. A heartfelt thank you to Fedora for creating such a safe and inspiring space. Highly recommended for anyone seeking a meaningful creative outlet.

featured_reviews.name: Stacy Alphonso
featured_reviews.review_text: The declutter your mind with art class was quite an enriching and deep experience. The environment created felt very warm and soothing. Fedora gave personal attention and observation that were insightful and helped me understand my art and state of mind better. The class is for anyone, for an artist it would help you work with different mediums that puts you out of your comfort zone, and for beginners it is good as you  understand the materials you can work with to express yourself.The class would help you take a break from a chaotic life.

featured_reviews.name: Joseph Sebastian Parackal (Ousu)
featured_reviews.review_text:
attended art and mindfully workshop conducted by Fedora for lawyers and kids at the Kerala High Court, with my daughter. Fedora's session on breathing excercises, mindfulness and micro dot painting was very interesting and captivating.

both of us thoroughly enjoyed the session and we have adopted some of the techniques Fedora showed us in our daily life and it has been helping us. thanks Fedora.

featured_reviews.name: Sibi Atul
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a lovely, interactive and invigorating session with Fedora in Cochin. She is very calm and friendly person, so easy to open up to. She creates a good atmosphere for her participants. Ours included kids as well and we had loads of fun. Do go for it.
